> The fastest way to get a part in is to add it yourself via a pull request —
> see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
> [docs/custom-components.md](../../docs/custom-components.md). But a request is
> welcome too!

**Part**
- Name:
- Brand / model:
- Category (fc / esc / vtx / camera / rx / gps / motor / battery / cap / buzzer / led / vrx / other):

**Datasheet / product page**
A link is hugely helpful for getting the specs and pinout right.

**Key specs (if known)**
- Voltage range:
- Current draw / continuous current:
- Weight:
- Dimensions / mount spacing:
- Cell range (for batteries/ESCs/VTXs):
- System (analog / dji / hdzero / walksnail), if relevant:

**Pads / pinout**
List the pads and what each is (VBAT, GND, 5V, 9V, TX, RX, video, motor phases, …).

**Anything else?**
